name: grokbot-mcp
description: Manage your Grok Bots from Claude: list, read, create, edit, delete, message, view routines, check usage.
long_description:
Unofficial. Uses the signed-in **Grok Bot** Windows desktop app session, so no tokens are copied or configured. Wakes the bot's cloud computer when it is asleep. Writes are two-step (preview, then confirm), edits are guarded by an etag, deleting needs the exact bot name, and messages are never resent automatically.

Requires the Grok Bot desktop app installed and signed in on this Windows PC. Not affiliated with xAI, Cursor or Anthropic; it talks to private APIs that can change without notice.

tools.name: grokbot_status
tools.description: Grok Bot health: app, sign-in, box awake/asleep.

tools.name: grokbot_list_bots
tools.description: List Grok bots (id, name, instructions preview).

tools.name: grokbot_get_bot
tools.description: Full bot config incl. instructions (hidden description) and etag (needed for update).

tools.name: grokbot_create_bot
tools.description: Create a bot. confirm=false (default) previews only.

tools.name: grokbot_update_bot
tools.description: Edit bot fields. Needs etag from grokbot_get_bot. confirm=false (default) shows a diff only. Server-run bots are written via an internal app endpoint that may change.

tools.name: grokbot_delete_bot
tools.description: Permanently delete a bot. confirm=false (default) previews; confirm=true also needs confirmName.

tools.name: grokbot_history
tools.description: Bot chat history, newest last. Cursors: before/after = entry # from a previous result.

tools.name: grokbot_routines
tools.description: A bot's routines: schedule, next run, prompt, last 5 runs. Read-only.

tools.name: grokbot_send
tools.description: Send a message to a bot. Returns a delivery receipt; never auto-resent.

tools.name: grokbot_usage
tools.description: Grok usage used/limit and reset time.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone for times shown in history and receipts, e.g. Europe/London. Leave blank to use this PC's time zone.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Write extra detail to the log file. Tokens are never logged.
